connected.basis: strategy rule: spread = 20d change of the H100 on-demand index minus the mean 20d change of CRWV and NBIS; z = spread z-score over the trailing 60 days; buy CRWV when z > +1.5 (the pair lags rising compute prices), sell CRWV when z < -1.5, hold otherwise. Only CRWV is traded; NBIS enters the spread only.
